title: TipReceipt
description: Portable receipt for an on-chain tip. Receiver gains Love; sender gains Care (aggregated at DisCONode).

to.description: did:peranto or node id of tip recipient (Love ↑)

amount.description: Tip amount in asset base units or decimal string

asset.description: Native token or CAIP-19 asset id (e.g. PAS, eip155:420420417/slip44:...)

periodHint.description: Optional accounting period id or block range hint

txHash.description: Optional on-chain transaction hash of the tip
